history.name: DaVinci Resolve — official downloads
history.summary: Updates edit-point and timeline controls, metadata, OGraf graphics and scripting, with media, monitoring and collaboration fixes.
changes: Adds support: Apple MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR touch screens.
Adds support: Blackmagic Design Gen 6 LUTs.
Extracted audio files now retain source timecode.
Multicam clips now open as source clips in source timelines.
Open in Timeline with Source Viewer supports clips and multicams.
Menu action and shortcut to restore last active edit points.
Command or Ctrl marquee selection now uses last edit point type.
Conform lock multiple timeline clips to one media pool clip.
Convert in out to compound clip replaces clips in situ.
Separate context action to create compound clip from in out range.
Stop playback option applies to playhead nudges and mouse clicks.
Edit menu options now persist after UI layout reset.
Adds support: EXIF metadata in PNG files.
Fixes: network drive audio issues for some MXF clips.
Fixes: slow MP3 audio only renders.
Fixes: missing clips in some AAF imports.
Fixes: incorrect audio timecode for AAF with interlaced media.
Fixes: OGraf template loading from network and zipped paths.
Fixes: OGraf render timeouts and memory usage issues.
Fixes: slow loading of media from XDCAM drives.
Fixes: flashing media offline frames with some H.265 clips.
Fixes: source track changes in collaboration source timelines.
Fixes: hang editing MultiText keyframes during render cache.
Fixes: issues with italics in imported TTML subtitles.
Fixes: data burn scaling issues for render resolutions.
Fixes: HE-AAC decode issues for some clips on Windows.
Fixes: incorrect channel order for WAV files with iXML tracks.
Fixes: crash decoding some multi-channel DNG files.
Fixes: render in place handles for frame based formats.
Fixes: audio input device preference reset after restart.
Fixes: GPU memory error for some OpenFX on Windows.
Fixes: artifacts in Sony XAVC Long GOP MXF renders.
Fixes: missing Text+ inspector controls in older projects.
Fixes: anchoring issue with Text+ CLS box extend controls.
Fixes: issues with CustomTool LUT name controls.
Fixes: clip EQ pasted Q and frequency attributes.
Fixes: ACES 2.0 artifacts on Windows and Linux.
Fixes: network paths with accented characters on macOS 27.
Fixes: file size estimates for spanned RED clips.
Updated Fusion tool and scripting reference developer documents.
General performance and stability improvements.
Studio: ResolveFX False Color support for Gen 5 and Gen 6 color science.
Studio: Improved AI assistant color and Fusion capabilities.
Studio: AI assistants can download extras needed for advanced features.
Studio: AI assistants can export frames or order thumbnails as grid.
Studio: Multiple scripting API improvements.
Studio: Fixes: loss of OpenFX from MultiMaster trim groups on reload.
Studio: Fixes: MainConcept H.265 CRF render crash.

history.name: DaVinci Resolve / Studio
history.summary: Media: editable pool fields, recursive/exact searches, geometry previews, timecode and marker batch edits, multicam dates and audio-track controls.
changes: Media: editable pool fields, recursive/exact searches, geometry previews, timecode and marker batch edits, multicam dates and audio-track controls.
Photo: panel-driven RAW settings, sharpening and sidebar improvements, DNG lens corrections, sky replacement and live-view shortcuts.
Editing: inspector presets, expanded multicam controls, timeline comparison, richer markers, waveform display, trim and gap operations, adjustment-clip transitions, backup and playback refinements.
Fusion: Krokodove shapes/3D, OpenPBR materials, MultiText and OGraf controls, DRFX macro editing, tracking import, blend/alpha improvements and metadata variables.
Color: LUT/DCTL relinking, missing-DCTL overlays, additional camera transforms, panel controls and effect scaling.
General: newer hardware/media decoding, HTJ2K EXR output, caption exports, media-management reporting, archive options and PostgreSQL 18 Project Server.
Compatibility: Python/advanced scripting now needs Studio; projects opened in 21.1 cannot reopen in 20.3.2. Apple Silicon and macOS 15 are required on Mac.

Studio additionally brings native MCP/AI integration, expanded Python APIs, MultiMaster trims, deep rendering improvements, extra RAW formats and effects. Read the separate full edition notes for every change and requirement.

history.name: DaVinci Resolve / Studio
history.summary: Exact patch identified; proxy relinking, X-OCN formats and timeline scripting updates.
changes: Proxy relinking now accepts mismatched formats.
Imported DRTs reconnect to matching nested clips already present.
Color-page filtering keeps the selected clip visible.
Older Affinity formats can be imported.
Sony FX-5 footage encoded as X-OCN is supported.
Scripts can retrieve the selected timeline clips.
Scripts can obtain a timeline object through its Media Pool entry.
Render-setting scripts gain controls for handles, extents and burn-ins.
Cached large timelines receive real-time playback fixes.
Media Pool Power Bin navigation is corrected.
Media management handles segment-clip suffixes correctly.
Edit Index sorting is corrected.
Pasting timecode no longer triggers the reported source-viewer audio problem.
Several speed-curve retiming problems are corrected.
Windows Fusion templates handle long paths correctly.
Burn-ins regain the missing marker-notes tag.
Decoding is corrected for affected DPX files.
Decoding is corrected for affected CR2 images.
Free-edition notes additionally report a Windows software H.264 decoding fix.
Additional reliability and speed improvements.
